messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your Apple LD (KAMINANGA@HOTMAIL.COM) was used to sign in to iCloud via a browser from another device and location.', 'Your AOL experience - 2 minute survey!', 'Dear AOL MEMBER YOUR AOL EMAIL ACCOUNT IS SCHEDULED FOR SUSPENSION.', 'Your webmail is full please upgrade now by clicking the link below to verify your webmail account.', 'Facebook Team sent you a message on Facebook...', "Alternative Option : Outlook Web Users Office 365 users Password Policy : * Minimum 8 Characters * Complex Password : Capital letters, small letters, numeric, special characters (3 out of 4) * Doesn't contain your name", 'Your mailbox has been migrated to the Exchange server COB-EXCH2K10-01.', 'Just click the link below and craft a session using your Apple ID and password.', 'Your Cornell.edu account Certificate expired on the 31-01-2017, this may interrupt your email delivery configuration, and account POP settings, page error when sending message.', 'Your mailbox might be closed, kindly VIEW TO UPDATE YOUR EMAIL NOW! to add more MB to your mailbox.', 'We have now standardized and updated our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, which govern our relationship with you', 'Our Message Center needs to be re-set Because of the high amount of spam mails we receive daily.', "We've upgraded our new SSL servers to serve our customers for a better and secure Webmail service, against any fraudulent activities.", 'Your two incoming mails were placed on pending status due to the recent upgrade to our database, and also exceeded the storage limit of 1 GB', 'We noticed that the Math Webmail accounts has been compromised by spammers.', 'Your account has being limited and will not be able to receive new and important message after 24 hours, due to system maintenance.', 'Facebook Notify sent you a message.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
